mh2_1a_v_over_non_reference.why: MH2.1 (a) is a convention this pre-registration did not invoke; the registered figure BINDS and this one is a diagnostic (E2.1-r).

deflation.note: ⚠️ The exclusion is NON-MONOTONE and is therefore not a lever: dropping a near-mean arm WIDENS the sample variance and RAISES the bar. It applies to the two arms named degenerate before any score, and to nothing else (DSR-CONV).

all_zero.why: no own-form peeking oracle — the check would pass on NOTHING

no_cap.why: no own-form peeking oracle — the check would pass on NOTHING

_matched_n_control.why: the peeking oracle is a FLOOR only at matched family AND matched resolution (NF1.7 (b) / NF1.9 (f)) — the winner's own form on ONE prior season

across_arms_STRICT_binds.reading: the 4 eligible arms as parallel hypotheses

single_hypothesis_diagnostic.reading: one mechanism, one population, no registered position axis ⇒ arguably INAPPLICABLE rather than failed

matched_foil.what_it_measures: timing_aware − timing_aware_minus_timing = the TIMING attribution. A primary win this does not separate is a win for the covariates the two SHARE, never for timing (NF-D10 / NF-D15).

channel_decomposition.reading: the LEVEL channel dominates by an order of magnitude — the hardcoded caps are simply too high; TIMING is a small positive increment and the HURDLE SPLIT (the certified NF-W2 transfer) is roughly twice the timing channel.

gate_choice_sensitivity.reading: two independent registered gates fail, so the null does not turn on either one alone; ⭐ but BOTH failures trace to a SPECIFICATION the pre-registration left open (the V-composition convention and the BH family), not to a threshold and not to the evidence — see the hand-written reading (NF-D20).

null_classification.reason: `nf_inj3_crps_hurdle_transfer`: the effect is positive and every gate is REACHABLE, but this design cannot resolve it — DSR alone needs 28 folds against 7 (the BH-FDR requirement is separate and may be larger). `V` is DSR-CONV-correct (measured EXCLUDING the pre-registered lose-by-construction degenerates, which remain in `n_trials`), so the field-size reading below is about the EVIDENCE.
null_classification.retest_trigger: +21 folds for the DSR gate — field size is NOT a lever here — even a 2-arm field does not clear at this fold count and dispersion, so the only lever left is a lower-variance design (more rows per fold / a sharper metric)

incumbent_reproduction.reading: 0 above the ceiling and a round-trip error at machine precision ⇒ the served board is on the incumbent cap path (blend 0.7, caps 4/4/4/7)

mae_inversion_check.reading: MAE is minimised at the conditional median, which sits AT the floor here ⇒ MAE pays for pessimism and CANNOT select. CRPS is primary (NF-D11/NF-D14).
